**Considering ID collisions**

I'm thinking about whether there's an issue with ID collisions when dealing with global and local entries. If I update a local entry to have a global flag set to true, does it create another entry with the same ID? It seems like storing the same ID across different scopes might not be allowed. Should I update the existing entry to be global, which likely changes the flags for both local and global?

Other demos (19x18, 26x20, 15x22, 21x23, 22x9) show complex selective recoloring; many background cells become 3 while markers and some background remain. Do not assume all background becomes 3 or every collinear marker pair determines a fill. On recurrence, infer the selective mask before submitting; preserve unrelated background. No validated general rule is known.''',global_=True)
